_readme: Named facts a paper may cite that are NOT derivable from cells.json -- counts and sizes read
out of a retrieved artifact rather than out of the ledger.
They live here, with their evidence, so that a manuscript can cite them by NAME and never by
typing the digit. build_paper.py resolves {{F:name}} from this file and fails if a name is
missing, which is the same discipline the emitted tables enforce for scores.
Each fact carries how it was obtained. A fact whose `check` does not say what was counted is
not a fact, it is a number somebody remembered.
Each fact now carries a `method` naming a REGISTERED recomputation, and check_facts.py
recomputes the value from the archived bytes. A fact whose method is not registered, or
whose bytes are not archived, FAILS -- it is not demoted to a remembered number.

olmo_data_paths.check: counted lines matching '^    - ' in the retrieved training config; all 1122 are http://olmo-data.org URLs

llama_readme_bytes.check: byte length of the retrieved document; the gate detector refused it on a soft marker, which is the defect reported in the paper

pythia_corpus_files.unit: files published at the corpus revision
pythia_corpus_files.check: counted entries of type 'file' in the retrieved Hugging Face tree response for EleutherAI/pile-standard-pythia-preshuffled at the pinned revision; 21 are Megatron token shards, one is the index, one is the Git-LFS configuration

pythia_range_tokens.unit: token ids returned by a byte-range request against the first corpus shard
pythia_range_tokens.check: 2,048 bytes retrieved by Range: bytes=0-2047 decode as 1,024 little-endian uint16 token ids, every one below the model config's declared vocab_size of 50,688. The HTTP 206 that carried them is recorded in the cell and replayed there; it is not recomputable from bytes and is deliberately not a fact here.
